sections.title: ERN IA/SRN WI/NRN IL THROUGH EARLY TONIGHT
sections.text: A WELL-DEFINED MCS AND EMBEDDED MCV HAS BEEN SUSTAINED OVERNIGHT ACROSS N CENTRAL IA/SRN MN BY LARGE MOISTURE FLUX AND WAA ON THE NOSE OF A 40-50 KT SWLY LLJ. THIS CONVECTIVE SYSTEM WILL WEAKEN SLOWLY THIS MORNING WHILE MOVING EWD/ENEWD FROM NE IA/SE MN TO SW WI AS IT MOVES AWAY FROM THE STRONGEST INSTABILITY AND THE LLJ VEERS/WEAKENS. MEANWHILE...THE SYNOPTIC WARM FRONT WILL MOVE NWD FROM NRN IL/ERN IA TO SRN WI AS THE MCS WEAKENS...AND THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON ALONG THE SYNOPTIC WARM FRONT AND/OR OUTFLOW BOUNDARY TRAILING WSWWD ACROSS NE IA/SW WI FROM THE REMNANT MCS. SURFACE HEATING AND BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE MID 70S WILL CONTRIBUTE TO MLCAPE VALUES OF 2500-3500 J/KG WITH MINIMAL CONVECTIVE INHIBITION ALONG AND S OF THE SURFACE BOUNDARIES BY EARLY-MID AFTERNOON...WHEN NEW THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS ANTICIPATED. DEEP-LAYER AND LOW-LEVEL VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS ALONG THE BOUNDARIES...WITH THE POSSIBILITY OF A COUPLE OF TORNADOES IN ADDITION TO DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL. THE AFTERNOON CONVECTION WILL THEN SPREAD EWD AS ONE OR MORE THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS INTO EARLY TONIGHT ACROSS SRN WI AND EXTREME NRN IL.

sections.title: ERN ND THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: AN EMBEDDED SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER ERN MT/SW ND WILL PROGRESS EWD ACROSS ND TODAY...WITH A WEAK SURFACE REFLECTION OF THE MIDLEVEL WAVE. SOME SURFACE HEATING AND RESIDUAL BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE 60S WILL CONTRIBUTE TO WEAK-MODERATE INSTABILITY THIS AFTERNOON...IN AN ENVIRONMENT WITH EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR NEAR 50 KT. THE MOST PROBABLE SCENARIO IS FOR NEW STORMS TO FORM THIS AFTERNOON ON THE ERN FRINGE OF THE ONGOING CONVECTION THAT IS NOW OVERSPREADING WRN ND...WITH A FEW SUPERCELLS POSSIBLE. AT LEAST ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL CAN BE EXPECTED...AND A BRIEF TORNADO CANNOT BE RULED OUT.

sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON/TONIGHT
sections.text: ISOLATED STRONG/SEVERE STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS ERN WY AND VICINITY WHERE BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE 50S AND SURFACE HEATING COINCIDE WITH SUFFICIENT DEEP-LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR FOR SUPERCELLS. STORM COVERAGE SHOULD BE ISOLATED DURING THE AFTERNOON...WITH THE STRONGEST STORMS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL. LATER TONIGHT...ANOTHER THUNDERSTORM CLUSTER COULD DEVELOP OVER SE MT AS AN UPSTREAM SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER SRN BC MOVES ESEWD ACROSS MT.

sections.title: S FL EARLY FRIDAY
sections.text: A MIDLEVEL TROUGH OVER THE WRN BAHAMAS WILL MOVE WWD OVER S FL THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT. E OF THE MIDLEVEL TROUGH AXIS...A SURFACE CYCLONE AND THUNDERSTORM CLUSTER IN THE SE BAHAMAS WILL LIKEWISE OVERSPREAD S FL LATE TONIGHT/EARLY FRIDAY. GIVEN THE POTENTIAL FOR TROPICAL CYCLONE DEVELOPMENT /SEE LATEST PRODUCTS FROM NHC/ AND THE PRESENCE OF AN ENHANCED BELT OF LOW-MIDLEVEL SLY/SELY FLOW E OF THE MIDLEVEL TROUGH...THERE WILL BE A THREAT FOR SUPERCELLS ACROSS S FL LATE TONIGHT WITH AN ASSOCIATED RISK FOR BRIEF TORNADOES AND/OR DAMAGING GUSTS. ..THOMPSON/GRAMS.. 07/22/2010

sections.title: UPPER MS VALLEY INTO NEB
sections.text: RELATIVELY FAST ZONAL FLOW IS PRESENT ONCE AGAIN TODAY OVER THE NORTHERN TIER OF STATES...WHILE A FLAT RIDGE EXTENDS FROM THE SOUTHEAST INTO THE DESERT SOUTHWEST. A LARGE REMNANT MCS IS TRACKING EASTWARD ACROSS MN/WI. THIS SYSTEM HAS SIGNIFICANTLY MODIFIED THE NEARBY ENVIRONMENT WITH STRONG SOUTHWESTERLY LOW LEVEL FLOW BEING OBSERVED ON THE SOUTHWEST FLANK ACROSS IA. THE TRAILING CONVERGENCE ZONE ASSOCIATED WITH THE MCS WILL LIKELY PERSIST FROM SOUTHERN WI INTO CENTRAL IA...AND SHOULD PROVIDE THE FOCUS FOR REDEVELOPMENT OF THUNDERSTORMS LATER THIS AFTERNOON. MORNING CLOUDS ARE RAPIDLY ERODING...SUGGESTING SUBSTANTIAL DESTABILIZATION MAY OCCUR. FORECAST SOUNDINGS SHOW MLCAPE VALUES OF 1500-2500 J/KG AND SUFFICIENT EFFECTIVE SHEAR FOR ORGANIZATION AND A FEW SUPERCELLS. GIVEN THE LOCALLY ENHANCED LOW LEVEL WINDS AND SHEAR DUE TO THE MCS...THERE IS A THREAT OF ISOLATED TORNADOES IN PARTS OF SOUTHERN WI/NORTHERN IA/NORTHERN IL LATER THIS AFTERNOON. OTHERWISE... DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL ARE THE MAIN THREATS. FARTHER SOUTHWEST...SURFACE BOUNDARY WILL EXTEND FROM WESTERN IA INTO SOUTHWEST NEB AND NORTHWEST KS. VERTICAL SHEAR WEAKENS WITH SOUTHWARD EXTENT...BUT STRONG CAPE VALUES MAY BE SUFF

sections.title: ND/SD/MN
sections.text: WATER VAPOR LOOPS SHOW A WELL-DEFINED SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING ACROSS MT/ND. THIS FEATURE WILL TRACK EASTWARD AND HELP TO INITIATE SCATTERED AFTERNOON THUNDERSTORMS OVER EASTERN ND/SD AND WESTERN MN. PERSISTENT LOW CLOUDS WILL SLOW DAYTIME HEATING AND DESTABILIZATION. HOWEVER...SUFFICIENT CAPE IS EXPECTED FOR A FEW STRONG/SEVERE STORMS BY LATE AFTERNOON AND EVENING CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL.

sections.title: SOUTH FL
sections.text: TD 3 IS EXPECTED TO BEGIN TO APPROACH SOUTH FL AND THE KEYS LATE TONIGHT. STRONGER LOW LEVEL SHEAR NEAR OUTER BANDS COULD POSE A LIMITED THREAT FOR BRIEF TORNADOES AFTER 06Z. ..HART/ROGERS.. 07/22/2010

sections.title: SRN LOWER MI
sections.text: A SUPERCELL HAS INTENSIFIED IN SWRN LOWER MI AND IS TRACKING EAST/SOUTHEASTWARD ALONG A WARM FRONT. ENHANCED LOW LEVEL SHEAR AND CONVERGENCE ALONG THE BOUNDARY WILL MAINTAIN A RISK OF ISOLATED TORNADOES FOR THE NEXT FEW HOURS.

sections.title: ND/SD/MN
sections.text: WEAK SURFACE LOW AND TROUGH WAS LOCATED ACROSS FAR ERN SD/ND AT MID AFTERNOON. MOSTLY CLOUDY SKIES HAVE COVERED MUCH OF THE REGION AND HAS LIMITED DESTABILIZATION. ALTHOUGH ELEVATED STORMS HAD DEVELOPED ACROSS PARTS OF FAR ERN ND AND NWRN MN...IT IS UNCERTAIN IF SURFACE BASED STORMS WILL DEVELOP GIVEN WEAKENING SURFACE CONVERGENCE AND UPPER FORCING SHIFTING NEWD INTO SRN CANADA. HOWEVER...GIVEN THAT TEMPERATURES MAY WARM A FEW DEGREES MORE IN FAR SERN ND/NERN SD AND SWRN MN...A SMALL SLIGHT RISK AREA HAS BEEN MAINTAINED FOR THIS AREA.

sections.title: NRN ID AND WRN MT
sections.text: UPPER LOW OVER BRITISH COLUMBIA IS FORECAST TO MOVE SEWD INTO SRN ALBERTA BY LATE TONIGHT. THIS WILL RESULT IN A 50-60 KT MID LEVEL JET MAX TO SPREAD ESEWD FROM WA INTO SRN MT. ALTHOUGH INSTABILITY IS NOT FORECAST TO BE PARTICULARLY STRONG...THE COMBINATION OF FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH UPPER LOW/SPEED MAX AND STEEPENING LAPSE RATES SHOULD RESULT IN FAVORABLE VERTICAL SOUNDINGS FOR THUNDERSTORMS TO DEVELOP. STRENGTHENING WIND FIELDS WILL PROVIDE SUFFICIENT DEEP LAYER SHEAR FOR SUPERCELLS...WITH A THREAT FOR ISOLATED HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS.

sections.title: UPPER MS VALLEY EWD INTO NEB
sections.text: FORECAST LOOKS ON TRACK...REFERENCE MD/S 1415 AND 1416.

sections.title: SOUTH FL
sections.text: NO CHANGES FROM PREVIOUS OUTLOOK. ..IMY.. 07/22/2010 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1058 AM CDT THU JUL 22 2010/

sections.title: GREAT LAKES REGION
sections.text: WARM FRONT EXTENDS FROM NRN OH WWD THROUGH SRN WI INTO NRN IA. MODERATE INSTABILITY EXISTS SOUTH OF THE FRONT /1500-2500 J/KG MLCAPE/ WITH WEAKER INSTABILITY WITH ERN EXTENT THROUGH THE OH VALLEY. A SWLY 40+ KT LOW-LEVEL JET FROM THE MID-MS VALLEY INTO THE UPPER GREAT LAKES INTERSECTING THE WARM FRONT IS RESULTING IN A ZONE OF SIGNIFICANT ISENTROPIC LIFT OVER THE GREAT LAKES AREA. STORMS WILL CONTINUE DEVELOPING WITHIN THIS ZONE OF LIFT THROUGH THE EVENING. EFFECTIVE SHEAR OF 40-50 KT IS SUPPORTING SUPERCELLS AND EMBEDDED BOWING SEGMENTS. LARGE 0-1 KM HODOGRAPHS EXIST NORTH OF THE WARM FRONT WITH 300-400 M2/S2 STORM RELATIVE HELICITY. THE BOUNDARY LAYER HAS NOT FULLY RECOVERED...SUGGESTING STORMS COULD BE SLIGHTLY ELEVATED ABOVE THE FRONT. HOWEVER...GIVEN RICH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE IN PLACE...STORMS WILL REMAIN CAPABLE OF INGESTING THE HELICITY RICH AIR NEAR THE SURFACE AND POSE A THREAT FOR ISOLATED TORNADOES. OVERNIGHT...THE LOW LEVEL JET WILL GRADUALLY VEER AND SHIFT EWD IN ASSOCIATION WITH PROGRESSIVE SHORTWAVE TROUGH.

sections.title: NERN SD THROUGH CNTRL AND NRN MN
sections.text: STORMS PERSIST WITHIN ZONE OF DEEPER ASCENT ATTENDING A SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND CONVERGENCE BOUNDARY MOVING EWD THROUGH MN. ATMOSPHERE REMAINS MARGINALLY UNSTABLE WITH 500-1000 J/KG MLCAPE ACROSS CNTRL INTO NWRN MN...AND STORMS ARE EMBEDDED WITHIN 40-50 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR. THREAT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND PERHAPS A TORNADO OR TWO MAY PERSIST FOR ANOTHER HOUR. HOWEVER...STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO CONTINUE AN OVERALL WEAKENING TREND THIS EVENING AS THE ZONE OF DEEPER ASCENT BEGINS TO SHIFT EAST OF THE MODEST INSTABILITY AXIS. ....CNTRL PLAINS AREA... SUPERCELLS STORMS THAT DEVELOPED OVER THE HIGH PLAINS ARE MOVING SEWD THROUGH SWRN SD AND WRN NEB. HOWEVER...MOISTURE IN THE NORTH PLATTE NEB 00Z RAOB DECREASES SUBSTANTIALLY ABOVE THE SURFACE AND SUGGEST THAT THE CAP WILL INCREASE SIGNIFICANTLY AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER COOLS. THIS INDICATES THAT ALTHOUGH STORMS MAY PERSIST INTO THE MID EVENING WITH A THREAT OF ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL...OVERALL TREND WILL PROBABLY BE FOR ACTIVITY TO DECREASE WITH TIME. POTENTIAL STILL EXISTS FOR ADDITIONAL STORMS TO DEVELOP FROM CNTRL NEB NEWD INTO IA ALONG SW-NE ORIENTED CONVERGENCE ZONE AS THE LOW LEVEL JET STRENGTHENS. THE 00Z RAOB FROM OMAHA

sections.title: NWRN SD...NERN WY AND ERN MT
sections.text: STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP IN THIS REGION LATE TONIGHT AS LARGE SCALE ASCENT INCREASES DOWNSTREAM FROM UPPER TROUGH MOVING INTO WRN NEB. STEEP LAPSE RATES...MODEST INSTABILITY AND 40+ KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR WILL SUPPORT A THREAT FOR HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS. HOWEVER...COVERAGE OF ANY SEVERE EVENTS WILL PROBABLY REMAIN TOO SPARSE FOR A CATEGORICAL OUTLOOK.

sections.title: S FL
sections.text: TS BONNIE IS FORECAST TO CONTINUE NWWD BY THE NHC TONIGHT WITH THE CENTER FORECAST TO BE WITHIN 150 MI SE OF THE FL KEYS BY 12Z FRIDAY. SOME INCREASE IN LOW LEVEL SHEAR WILL OCCUR TONIGHT...AND A MODEST THREAT FOR AN ISOLATED TORNADO OR TWO MAY DEVELOP LATE IN ASSOCIATION WITH STORMS LOCATED WITHIN OUTER BANDS. HOWEVER...OVERALL THREAT DOES NOT APPEAR SUFFICIENT TO WARRANT A CATEGORICAL RISK AT THIS TIME. ..DIAL.. 07/23/2010
